name: Owl Wing in Ghost Town, Bodie California
description: Looking into a dirty window in the ghost town of Bodie California is a abandoned room with a large wing of a barn owl that meet a bad fate by being trapped and paniced.  Dead birds are one of the gristly, filthy, diseased, and disturbing things that one finds in ghost towns.  The scene evokes images of a nightmare for the owl and a place that you would not want to be in when it was happening.

9 photos with Sony X Compact. Made with ContextCapture.

name: The Night Owl's Cubicle
description:
This 3D asset pack was produced for CQUniversity: MMST12017 3D Computer Graphics’ Assignment 2: 3D diorama and self assessment

An oddity of the company, this one worker continues their plan of being a night owl. While everyone else has gone home, they still have their lamp on, calculator calculating, computer open, and pen writing. Unfortunately, the newton's cradle proved too distracting, so it was put to sit alongside the two dead lamps in the back area.

As usual, the coffee is still cold.
